term: direct common root of the selected actual concrete domain
definition: There is n with ActualRoot m w n, and each x with ActualConcrete m w x is either equal to n or directly ActualConcreteGround m w n x. The identity alternative covers n without requiring a self-ground edge.
note: Reuses EXACT existing Profile/ActualRoot/ActualConcreteGround at one world; introduces no causal relation or second ontology. Direct edge coverage is stronger than merely one root existing or every node having a predecessor. Abstract/absent/nonconcrete and other-world bearers are outside the quantified domain. No necessity, universal modal actuality, God, cross-world roothood, explanatory completeness or well-foundedness is included. Arbitrary extra chains/cycles among dependent actual members are not excluded just by this endpoint; members unrelated to n by identity or the stated direct edge fail coverage. No new model or metaphysical-possibility certificate is supplied. E/I/F/grades and formal whole-roster interpretation remain OPEN; this is conditional structural progress, not independent reality applicability.
